value.signature: fn coefficient (cell : & StandingCell , limits : Limits) -> Result < String , CoefficientError >

review.body: { let names = MANDATORY_COORDINATES . iter () . find (| (family , _) | * family == cell . identity . family) . map (| (_ , names) | * names) . ok_or (CoefficientError :: Representation) ? ; if cell . coordinates . len () != names . len () { return Err (CoefficientError :: Representation) ; } let mut budget = Budget :: new (limits) ? ; let one = Rational :: parse ("1" , & mut budget) ? ; let mut product = one . clone () ; for name in names { let mut value = Rational :: parse (cell . coordinates . get (* name) . ok_or (CoefficientError :: Representation) ? , & mut budget ,) ? ; if value . is_negative () { value = value . negated (& mut budget) ? ; } if value . compare (& one , & mut budget) ? . is_gt () { return Err (CoefficientError :: Representation) ; } product = product . mul (& value , & mut budget) ? ; } let spelling = product . exact_string (& mut budget) ? ; if names . len () < 2 || product . is_zero () { return Ok (spelling) ; } let (numerator , denominator) = spelling . split_once ('/') . unwrap_or ((& spelling , "1")) ; let n = integer_root (numerator , & mut budget) ? ; let d = integer_root (denominator , & mut budget) ? ; match (n , d) { (Some (n) , Some (d)) => Ok (n . div (& d , & mut budget) ? . exact_string (& mut budget) ?) , _ => Err (CoefficientError :: Irrational { radicand : spelling }) , } }
review.item_premise: Coefficient evaluation consumes one public folded cell and explicit exact-arithmetic limits. Mandatory magnitudes, exact rational results, malformed-input refusals and irrational radicands remain fully observable. Invitation uses its urgency/formality pair; an empty mandatory set, including De-invite, weighs one. This operation neither resolves a recipient nor reads private openings, and observation changes no coefficient.
